svg.text: MLIR Tensor Partitioning - GSPMD + PartIR - openxla.org/shardy - github.com/openxla/shardy
L1 - Framework / User Input (attach shardings to StableHLO programs)
L2 - Logical Mesh (sdy.mesh - axis-based device topology)
L3 - sdy Dialect Compiler APIs (user control over sharding)
Group tensors by ID - same sharding
Manual SPMD sub-region on mesh subset
p0/p1 priority tags - batch par then Megatron then ZeRO
L4 - Sharding Propagation Engine (bidirectional fixed-point on data-flow graph)
Repeat until fixed point - no sharding changes without undo
Traverse use-def chains in both directions
Heuristics: prefer batch dims - minimize comm cost
Propagate sources-targets as identity sharding rule
Combines GSPMD attribute propagation + PartIR incremental/user-priority control
L5 - Dialect-Agnostic Interfaces (long-term: any MLIR dialect)
L6 - SPMD Partitioner Output (lower sharding decisions to distributed program)
StableHLO module with partial sdy.sharding + constraint ops
Step 1: Parse sdy.mesh + user shardings on func args/results/intermediates
Step 2: User-priority rounds - propagate batch then Megatron then ZeRO axes
Step 3: Op-priority rounds - elementwise - broadcast - matmul via OpShardingRule
Step 4: Fixed point - every op has sdy.sharding - constraint - sdy.reshard
Step 5: Export to XLA - GSPMD SPMD partitioner inserts collectives - codegen
Shardy unifies GSPMD + PartIR + Mesh Dialect best practices
Shardy adds: axis-based repr, reshape handling, Model Explorer, open source
Predictable incremental partitioning - broader contributor base
Future: native MLIR SPMD partitioner replaces GSPMD backend
Dialect-agnostic goal: any MLIR dialect via ShardingRuleOpInterface + traits
Today: StableHLO-centric - lifting dependency via abstractions in progress
Predictable partitioning - axis-based debuggability - MLIR-native - framework/compiler neutral - GSPMD successor
Init path: framework attaches sdy.mesh + shardings/constraints on StableHLO module
Step path: sdy-propagation-pipeline - full sharding attrs - XLA GSPMD partition - collectives - PJRT execute
Sources: openxla.org/shardy - github.com/openxla/shardy - LLVM DevMtG 2024 - GSPMD/PartIR papers - xla/service/spmd/shardy
